ACTION 11 OF 32 · PHASE 03

Show the preview to real customers

Find confusion and buying objections quickly.

WHEN TO DO THISBefore funding a full build.ESTIMATED WORK TIME2–7 days
↗
Your one job

Find confusion and buying objections quickly.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Show the site to five target users if feasible; ask them to complete the main action without help.

  2. 02

    Note where they pause, misinterpret the offer or ask questions.

  3. 03

    Record how many reach the requested action and what still needs explaining.

  4. 04

    Revise only the biggest obstacles; do not chase stylistic preferences that don't affect understanding.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Give me a neutral five-person usability-test script for this preview. Tasks: explain the offer, find the price/quote process, determine if the business is trustworthy, and start the enquiry flow. Create a table for participant, friction, quote, result and priority. Do not suggest leading questions that bias the responses.
03

Finish with this

A usability observation log and revised prototype.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Participants are representative of target buyers
  • Real task outcomes recorded
  • At least one obvious friction point is addressed
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Asking only 'Do you like the design?' and calling that testing.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A customer can understand the offer and find the next action on mobile without explanation.
